newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sun Intl Hotels started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sun Intl Hotels started.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Inc analyst Jim Murren said he started coverage of hotel/casino operator Sun International Hotels with a buy rating, based on its success in the Bahamas, its new Mohegan Sun Casino in Connecticut, and its purchase of Griffin Gaming, which gives it an Atlantic City hotel/casino.
-- Murren said in a report he believes Sun will earn $1.58 a share in 1996, $2.43 in 1997 and $3.49 in 1998.
-- He has a 12-month target of $60 on the stock and a 24-month target at $78.
-- Sun shares were up 7/8 to 53 at midday.
